name: io.github.extralabs/octowatch-mcp
title: OctoWatch DLP
description: Read-only OctoWatch DLP Cloud MCP: risks, idle time, productivity, monitoring.

environmentVariables.name: OCTOWATCH_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Cloud API host (serverBase). Default: public cloud.

environmentVariables.name: OCTOWATCH_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Console operator email. Demo default works for try-out.

environmentVariables.name: OCTOWATCH_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Console password. Use a least-privilege operator for real tenants.

environmentVariables.name: OCTOWATCH_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Tool filter: all | core | console (console includes core).
